coursesText1: All updates regarding course start dates and times will be uploaded to the website. Course participants will be informed again by email or telephone after paying the course fee. The courses will take place using PDF documents via Microsoft Teams. At the request of the course group, the pace of teaching can be slowed down.
coursesText2: Prices vary depending on the level – please contact us on WhatsApp for specific information.
translationText: On request, we also offer certified translations (French-German, German-French) in Germany. These are professional translations for certificates, diplomas, court documents, contracts, agreements, official correspondence, etc. If you need a translation from a translator sworn in Germany, you have come to the right place. Please check beforehand whether you need a standard or a certified translation.
aboutText1: Hey! I am Amira, half Tunisian, and I have been passionate about languages since my childhood. I was born in Germany and grew up bilingual. After completing my studies, I had the opportunity to get to know my second home country, Tunisia, better through internships abroad and to live there for the first time. I enjoy helping people learn German and inspiring them to love the language. In addition to German culture, I want to give them an insight into everyday life and lifestyle and prepare them for this new phase in their lives with tips and advice.
aboutText2: At amilangues, we are friends who learn together and have fun in class. The atmosphere in our courses is always relaxed, with German conversation playing a major role. It is important to me that you familiarise yourself with the German language in a playful way and at your own pace, and that you feel comfortable. Just like meeting up with friends! I hope we can meet in person soon!
